method: esbuild ESM bundle, minified, NODE_ENV production; every package import (React, react-dom, react/jsx-runtime) stays external; then gzip -9 of the output. An engine is its entries with relative imports outside its scope kept external. An adapter is what windowing adds to a bundle that already holds its host and the engine: the host built with the adapter, minus the host built with the adapter modules stubbed out, minus the engine. budgetBytes is the gzipped size.
enforce: Set when the converged engine lands; over-budget then needs the owner's OK.
